_comment: The canonical economy-loop fixture. The honest post-onboarding state (warrior L1, met/sparred/given_spear) but standing at the INN spawn (2,3) with an EMPTY purse (gold 0) -- economy_loop needs an inn chore (gold is inn-only earn) AND Krshia's street shop AND a loot fight, so the run starts in the inn and walks the mandatory floodplains ambush (Relc-allied, deterministic) to reach the street. rng_state governs the two fights (ambush + street crate_scavengers); it is tuned so both are won. LOOT gold is isolated by the CLI --seed (=9, hash(run_seed,encounter_id)) not this rng_state, so both encounters drop gold 2 at seed 9 exactly as loot_probe verified -- independent of the fight-outcome rng_state. gold is an additive-optional save field (default 0, no version bump).
